name: 快看漫画
description: 官网公开目录、搜索及免费可读章节；付费、登录、App 专享和访问验证限制原样保留，不提供解锁。Nuxt 仅按有界字面量数据解析，绝不执行网页脚本。

attribution.implementation: Independent JavaScript implementation of public request/response protocol; no upstream source code copied.
attribution.modifications: Replaced upstream arbitrary QuickJs Nuxt evaluation with a bounded literal/alias data parser; supports current comics field in ascending source order, legacy comicList reversal, explicit access restriction errors, and HTTPS image validation. No Android/WebView/dependency or host changes.
attribution.bounds: Public general manga only. No authentication automation, paywall bypass, App unlock, anti-bot bypass, arbitrary website evaluation, or image URL fabrication.
